_reference: postsynaptic_ec50/hill set EQUAL to the presynaptic ec50/hill -- deliberate modeling choice, not a placeholder guess: unlike 5-HT1A's autoreceptor vs postsynaptic split (two anatomically distinct receptor pools with literature-sourced differential ligand affinity, F13714 vs F15599), D2's presynaptic and postsynaptic pathways are the SAME receptor subtype (D2) expressed at different synaptic locations -- no literature basis found this session for a large affinity difference between the two pools, so the same dose-occupancy curve drives both, differing only in which downstream lever it scales (release-probability reduction vs Ca2+-conductance reduction) and each pathway's own effect ceiling. max_postsynaptic_ca_reduction=0.5 mirrors max_release_reduction's magnitude for a symmetric first-pass shape check -- both are illustrative, not literature-calibrated magnitudes (same caveat class as 5-HT1A's max_autoreceptor_suppression).
